name: ProxyManager
description: 🎩✨🌈 OOP Proxy wrappers/utilities - generates and manages proxies of your objects

issues.title: Better support for internal PHP classes default parameters
FileLocator::getProxyFileName fails PSR-0/PSR-4 autoloading when no classmap is defined
ValueHolder proxy for class with accessing to private property within final method
Setting property default value to enum points to invalid namespace
[From PHP-DI] `__destruct` magic method being called before lazy Proxy creates value #669
Proxies for __set/__unset need special handling if the parent implementation return type is explicitly declared as void
Move internal implementation from Zend\Code to PHP-Parser
Promoted readonly properties are not respected
